text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, huh.
You gave it your all, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...She'd gotten even stronger. If I'd messed up
my timing by even a split second, I wouldn't have stood a chance.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Don't say "as expected"—how about telling me it's "only natural"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Was I number one this time?
...The "number one Umamusume," who won't lose to her.
choice_data_list: What do you think about it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't answer a question with another question.
...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not satisfied.
That's my answer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us decide on our next goal.
If possible, I would like to keep running with this momentum.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Then how about the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, more than taking first place...
I just wanted to beat you."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Constantly losing just ain't my style.
Let's get right on to the next race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is right around the corner.
...I'll be waiting for you there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Shall we register for the race?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely show you a victory next time too...!
